description: This file defines a logging utility using the pino library, including custom serializers for Fastify requests and responses, a deduplicating transform stream, and a function to obtain a configured logger instance.

classes.name: DeduplicatingTransform
classes.description: A custom Transform stream that deduplicates log entries by parsing and re-stringifying JSON log lines.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a configured pino logger instance based on environment variables, with optional pretty printing or deduplication.
